narrative.overview:
A dark console with one gemstone-red signal. The page sits on near-black (#050505), headings are pure white, body copy is cool slate, and a single ruby accent (#E0115F) marks everything that is live, selected or clickable. Type is monospace throughout, which gives the site its engineered character without any ornament beyond a few terminal-style cues (a blinking _ cursor, uppercase labels, /// separators, a glitch-effect name in the hero).

The voice is dry and a little witty, in the same register as the AI-tier labels on projects. The look stays restrained and tidy: generous space between sections, simple two-column layouts, hairline borders instead of shadows. Confidence comes from contrast and a single hot color, not from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, white headlines, slate body text, one ruby accent.
Monospace everywhere; uppercase tracked labels for system-style metadata.
Flat and border-defined: depth through slate hairlines and tonal panels.
Terminal vocabulary used as seasoning (cursor, ///, glitch), never as the whole layout.
Motion is scroll-driven reveal, plus one signature glitch in the hero.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Ruby is the only chromatic color in the interface. Anything else that needs emphasis uses white or a slate step.

rules.name: The Uppercase-For-System Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and wide tracking are reserved for system-style metadata and the hero role line. Prose is always sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. There are no shadows.

dos: Do keep Ruby (#E0115F) as the only accent and use it on short, meaningful signals: dates, hover states, badges, cursors.
Do use Void Black (#050505) for the page and Hairline Slate (#1e293b) for every border.
Do keep copy dry and plain, with one small joke at a time.
Do use uppercase tracked mono only for system-style labels and keep prose in sentence case.
Do respect the 6xl (1152px) container and the large section rhythm when adding sections.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to cards; no shadows.
Don't introduce a second accent color or any gradient fills.
Don't put a phone number on the site.
Don't pile on terminal gimmicks; the layout stays simple and tidy.
Don't rely on Inter or JetBrains Mono being loaded; the rendered voice is the system monospace stack until a font is explicitly wired in.
